premises.text: Meetings waste enormous time because agendas are missing and meeting details, people, content, and follow-ups are scattered across tools
premises.evidence_span: Dave's meeting details and content are scattered everywhere

premises.text: A mobile app organizes notes, photos, follow-up tasks, and contacts in the context of each meeting synced with calendar and collaborative capture
premises.evidence_span: It's a mobile app that puts your notes, photos, follow-up tasks, and contact information in the context of a meeting

premises.text: Users later retrace prior meetings to complete follow-ups and prepare, making teams more prepared and efficient
premises.evidence_span: later retrace your steps from previous meetings and take action

premises.text: Bottom-up individual adoption leads to premium team offerings that integrate with cloud storage, CRMs, and task systems
premises.evidence_span: bring value to the individual and drive adoption from the bottom up

value.text: Workforce becomes more productive by remembering and organizing everything about their meetings
value.evidence_span: making meetings and the people in them more productive

causal_links.evidence_span: Meetings are a waste of time
the best way to remember and organize everything about the meetings you've had
This will allow companies and teams to collaborate and share data about their meetings

notes: Scattered calendar/photos/notebook/inbox pains folded as one meeting-organization problem (§4.1.6). Trace/retrace/succeed feature cascade largely folded into capture+retrace product premises (§4.1.7); retrace/action kept as the second phase of the same app path. Dropbox/Yammer GTM coded as distinct go-to-market module. Singleton D1/D3 retained. Anti-template: problem, product workflow, and GTM separately revisable.
